status: retrospective mechanism-driven development; not blinded validation or preregistration
rationale: Earlier component audit shows different operating-stock and planned-entry errors. Test preserving the published operating-stock schedule while applying the already frozen rolling-origin frequencies only to Planned projects. Do not change training thresholds, horizons, fallback, region weights or unseen-entry estimator.
existing_stock: Operating-sheet records use origin-known status, retirement dates and announced capacity modifications, identically to announced_schedule. This is a conditional schedule, not guaranteed supply.
planned_projects: Planned-sheet records use the previous capacity-weighted target-OP frequency and origin size, with no new calibration or region-specific tuning.
open_supply: Reuse exactly the previous rolling-origin unseen-entry contribution; no additional extrapolation or fitted intercept.
sample: unchanged 175 physical inventory and 120 fixed-origin wind/solar-adjusted index cases; prespecified origin>=2022 and lead<=2 remains a secondary scope
target: reported-known June OP BA inventory, not firm seasonal resources or native NERC planning balances; target missing ratings remain unresolved
acceptance: lower MAE than both persistence and announced schedule, positive improvements in all omit-one-region and omit-one-origin evaluations, and positive region-block lower confidence limits against both; passing this component gate would still not authorize EIA-to-NERC full-balance substitution
native_annual_check: fresh extraction of seven NERC LTRA 2025 summer tables and ERCOT provisional response; independently reconstruct 1050 annual balances, exact annual decomposition, and all 388800 paired DC replacement contributions
novelty_checks: direct same-input annual accounting is an expected null, not a novel predictor
annual versus endpoint comparisons retain all four source resource-response conditions and separate timing stresses
DC pressure, added requirement and cushion consumption are paired within the same background before aggregation
MISO zero linked response is the principal controlled anchor; positive association is an outer structural bound
ERCOT associated response is scenario-specific, not measured DC-only causal response
hold resource background fixed in paired attribution and disclose inability to identify induced supply
display: reuse the existing framework-comparison protocol selection; do not choose attractive curves after examining new outputs
preservation: new directory only; all old data, code, main/SI, figures and remote repositories unchanged
